one operation: one pass over every token, strings decoded, numbers converted · geometric mean over the inputs both handled of MB/s ÷ JsonBeef JsonReader's · higher is better
MB/s · the three fastest implementations of this track on each input · bars scaled per input
* RapidJSON SAX failed canada and hard floats (default float conversion is not always correctly rounded).
* serde_json visitor failed canada and hard floats (float conversion not correctly rounded without its float_roundtrip feature).
* ijson failed integers (its yajl backend rejects integers above INT64_MAX).
